heading: Where Data Becomes
body: From ETL pipelines to interactive dashboards — each project is a chance to solve something real.

projects.title: Conversational Restaurant Finder
projects.short: AI-powered restaurant discovery chatbot that understands natural-language preferences and recommends relevant restaurants based on location and semantic search

projects.title: Macroeconomic Analytics Pipeline
projects.short: An ELT pipeline that moves IMF and World Bank data through Snowflake and dbt into a tested star schema, connected to a Power BI dashboard for broad overview.

projects.title: Stock Portfolio Analysis Tool
projects.short: A data-driven tool that combines portfolio holdings with live market and financial data to provide a comprehensive view of investment performance.
